decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (30639-PL-175 received on 2nd October 2018 and Site Location Plan received 3rd October 2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Details of any external lighting, including lux levels, direction, hours of operation and any screening, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before first occupation of the development hereby permitted. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to occupation and so maintained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 4 - The development shall be carried out and operate in accordance with the approved Barrier Control Management Plan v3 dated July 2017 approved under reference 00096/B/P48(11i,31ii) and so maintained at all times thereafter.
description: Erection of a gatehouse to the entrance of the site
